prompt.zh-TW: 小山咖啡今年本期淨利 {{money:vars.profit}}，但營業活動的現金流量總計只有 {{money:vars.ocf}}；年底流動負債 {{money:vars.cl}}，現金流量比率只有 {{percent:vars.ratio}}（見上表）。哪一個判讀最合理？
prompt.en: Hillside Coffee reports profit for the period of {{money:vars.profit}}, but net cash from operating activities of only {{money:vars.ocf}}; current liabilities at year end are {{money:vars.cl}}, giving a cash flow ratio of only {{percent:vars.ratio}} (see the table above). Which reading is most reasonable?

text.zh-TW: 本業賺進的現金只夠支應一小部分流動負債，短期還款壓力不小
text.en: Operating cash covers only a small part of current liabilities, so short-term repayment pressure is considerable

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。利益和現金是兩回事，這個比率提醒小山咖啡：賺到的錢還沒有變成足夠的現金。
feedback.en: That’s right. Profit and cash are different things, and this ratio warns Hillside Coffee that the profit has not yet turned into enough cash.

text.zh-TW: 既然本期淨利是正的，現金流量比率不該這麼低，數字可能算錯了
text.en: With a positive profit for the period the cash flow ratio should not be this low, so the figure may be wrong

feedback.zh-TW: 你把利益和現金連在一起想，這是很自然的直覺。不過賒銷做出的利益還沒變成現金，所以淨利為正、營業現金卻很少是常見的情況，數字沒有算錯。
feedback.en: Linking profit and cash is a natural instinct. But profit made on credit sales has not yet become cash, so a positive profit alongside little operating cash is common; the figure is not wrong.

text.zh-TW: 現金流量比率低，表示小山咖啡的負債不多，負債比率也會偏低
text.en: A low cash flow ratio means Hillside Coffee has few liabilities, so its debt ratio will be low as well

feedback.zh-TW: 現金流量比率的分母是流動負債、分子是營業現金，比率低反而表示流動負債相對營業現金偏多；它和負債占資產的比例是不同的問題，一個低不代表另一個也低。
feedback.en: The cash flow ratio divides operating cash by current liabilities, so a low ratio actually means current liabilities are large relative to operating cash; it is a different question from the share of assets funded by liabilities, and one being low says nothing about the other.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_555a7d2s}}用的是{{term:tm_e61ht6yh}}，不是{{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}}。{{option:o_sswg}}正確讀出『有利益、缺現金』的訊號；{{option:o_ce4c}}把利益當成現金，{{option:o_bfsb}}把兩個不同的比率混在一起。
explanation.en: The {{term:tm_555a7d2s}} uses {{term:tm_e61ht6yh}}, not {{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}}. {{option:o_sswg}} reads the ‘profit but little cash’ signal correctly; {{option:o_ce4c}} treats profit as cash, and {{option:o_bfsb}} confuses two different ratios.
